state.output:
<stdout>
Usage: python -m propscan [OPTIONS]

  PropScan - Scan for proprietary software on Linux systems.

  Supports Flatpak, Pacman, APT, and DNF package managers.

Options:
  -m, --manager [flatpak|pacman|apt|dnf]
                                  Scan specific package manager only
  -f, --format [table|json|simple]
                                  Output format (default: table)
  -l, --list-managers             List available package managers and exit
  -v, --verbose                   Enable verbose output
  --version                       Show the version and exit.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

</stdout>
<stderr>

</stderr>
